entry.title: Likely: Apple launches OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros and an M6 lineup at its Oct 28 launch
entry.summary: At its Oct 28 launch Apple will announce OLED touchscreen 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros (M5 Pro/Max), an OLED iPad mini, a 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro and an M6 iMac, with sales from Nov 6.

entry.title: Confirmed: Honor Win 2 and Win 2 RT launch in October
entry.summary: Honor's Win 2 and Win 2 RT phones launch this month with 100W/90W charging and 10,000mAh+ batteries.

entry.title: Confirmed: OPPO Find X10 launches worldwide on Oct 21
entry.summary: OPPO's Find X10 goes on sale on Oct 21.

entry.title: Rumor: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro both get 200MP main cameras
entry.summary: Both OnePlus Ace 7 models will use a 200MP main camera, and the Pro adds a 50MP 3.5x periscope.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 and S27+ start with just 8GB of RAM
entry.summary: Because of soaring memory prices, Samsung will sell 8GB/256GB versions of the Galaxy S27 and S27+ alongside 12GB/512GB models, while the S27 Pro and Ultra start at 12GB.

entry.title: Rumor: Samsung launches six foldables in 2027, including a rollable Galaxy Z Slide
entry.summary: Samsung's 2027 line-up will have six Galaxy Z devices: Z Flip9, Z Fold9, Z Fold9 Pro, Z Fold9 Ultra, Z TriFold2 and a rollable Z Slide, with the TriFold 2 arriving first.

entry.title: Shaky: AMD's 'Gainsborough' APU powers the Steam Deck 2
entry.summary: An AMD engineering sample codenamed Gainsborough, with six Zen 6-family cores and 24GB of LPDDR5-9600 in testing, is the chip for Valve's Steam Deck 2.

entry.title: Rumor: Huawei Mate X8 foldable launches in November
entry.summary: Huawei will launch the Mate X8 in China in November with Kirin 9050/9050 Pro chips, an 8.15-inch inner and 6.5-inch cover screen, a 50MP 1/1.28-inch variable-aperture main camera, a 50MP periscope and a battery above 6,000mAh, plus a privacy-display version.

entry.title: Rumor: Exynos Galaxy S27 models get a more efficient M2700 modem
entry.summary: Exynos versions of the Galaxy S27 will use a new 4nm Samsung M2700 modem with Release 18 support, better satellite connectivity and idle power use on par with rivals; the Galaxy S28 follows with a 2nm M2800.

entry.title: Rumor: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Pro Max cost EUR 1,449-1,849 in Europe with smaller batteries
entry.summary: The European Xiaomi 18 Pro will cost EUR 1,449 (256GB) or EUR 1,649 (512GB) with a 6,000mAh-rated battery and 90W charging, and the 18 Pro Max EUR 1,849 (512GB) with a 7,050mAh-rated battery and 100W, both smaller than the Chinese versions' 7,000mAh and 8,500mAh.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 Unpacked lands around Feb 24, 2027
entry.summary: Samsung will hold its Galaxy S27 Unpacked in late February 2027, possibly on Feb 24.

entry.title: Shaky: Galaxy S27 Ultra may switch to Exynos 2700 because Snapdragon overheats
entry.summary: Samsung found the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 overheating in S27 Ultra testing and may use its own Exynos 2700 chip if Qualcomm doesn't fix it by mid-October.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 series launches in early January 2027
entry.summary: Samsung plans to launch the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra in early January 2027, a few weeks earlier than the S25 and S26.

entry.title: Rumor: PlayStation 6 costs $1,000 or more
entry.summary: Memory and storage alone will cost Sony about $680 per PS6, pushing the console's price to $1,000 or more.

entry.title: Rumor: vivo X500 Ultra uses the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and a 7,000mAh battery
entry.summary: The vivo X500 Ultra launches in China around March-April 2027 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a flat 6.85-inch 2K 144Hz BOE LTPO screen, an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor and a battery of about 7,000mAh.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple plans a bigger HomeView with a 9-inch screen on a robotic arm
entry.summary: Apple is developing a higher-end HomeView smart home hub with a 9-inch screen that swivels 360 degrees on a robotic arm, for 2027 or 2028.

entry.title: Shaky: NVIDIA RTX 50 Super cards debut at CES 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will launch the RTX 5060 Super (12GB), 5070 Super (18GB) and 5070 Ti/5080 Super (24GB) around CES 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: NVIDIA RTX 60 series slips to 2028
entry.summary: The next GeForce generation will miss 2027 and reach retail in 2028; AMD will have only one RDNA 5 GPU in 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: GTA VI comes to PC in Q1 2027
entry.summary: Rockstar plans to release the PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI in the first quarter of 2027, a few months after the Nov 19 console launch.

entry.title: Rumor: NVIDIA swaps the RTX 5080 to 24GB in Q1 2027
entry.summary: NVIDIA will release an RTX 5080 with 24GB of GDDR7 in early 2027, gradually replacing the 16GB model.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 Ultra gets thinner bezels and a thicker camera bump
entry.summary: The Galaxy S27 Ultra will have 1.28mm screen bezels (vs 1.32mm on the S26 Ultra) and a 4.69mm camera bump, slightly thicker than today's.

entry.title: Likely: Standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e arrive in spring 2027
entry.summary: Apple is splitting its iPhone releases: Pro and foldable models in fall, the standard iPhone 18 and 18e in spring.

entry.title: Likely: Galaxy S27 family has four models, including a compact S27 Pro
entry.summary: Samsung will release the Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra.

entry.title: Rumor: Galaxy S27 parts ramp to mass production in mid-October
entry.summary: Some Galaxy S27 components entered mass production in September, with all four models ramping in mid-October.

entry.title: Likely: Intel Nova Lake-S desktop CPUs debut at CES 2027
entry.summary: Intel will launch Core Ultra 400 'Nova Lake-S' desktop chips at CES 2027, with first retail models in Q1 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: AMD Zen 6 desktop chips show up at CES 2027
entry.summary: AMD's Zen 6 'Olympic Ridge' desktop CPUs will be revealed at CES 2027 with retail from March to June 2027.

entry.title: Rumor: OpenAI's first device is a screenless smart speaker with a camera
entry.summary: The first Jony Ive-designed OpenAI device is a hockey-puck-sized speaker with a camera and sensors, priced around $200-$300.

entry.title: Rumor: Apple unveils smart glasses at WWDC 2027
entry.summary: Apple will show privacy-focused smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them in late 2027.

entry.title: Likely: PS6 and the next Xbox slip because of the memory shortage
entry.summary: Sony's PS6 and Microsoft's next Xbox (Project Helix) will launch later than planned because of high memory prices.

entry.title: Shaky: Tesla unveils Optimus V3 before the end of 2026
entry.summary: Tesla will publicly show its Optimus V3 humanoid robot in 2026.
